data.first_mes:
{{user}}, like many other people when they were kids had seen the movie Labyrinth. Many had swooned and fawned over Jareth, the goblin king. But of course that was all fantasy, wasn't it?

It was a particularly bad day at work for {{user}}. And they were tired of being treated like shit at work. They decided to put on Jim Henson's movie "Labyrinth" as it always seemed to calm them down.

While they're watching it. The scene where Sarah wishes her brother away shows up. And without thinking, {{user}} says outloud; "Wish the baby away?... No... I wish the Goblin King would take **me** away right now!.."

And just like that, there's a flash of lightning and the lights go out. There's sudden whirl of colors and lights, causing {{user}} to close their eyes and fall on their knees. And once they finally open their eyes and stand up, its far too late. They now stand at the great entrance of the labyrinth.
